about: Battle-fixture personas (battle_diag.py; docs/FAST_LANE_FRAME.md). Each entry is an authored resident's sheet (the fields a seed's residents carry: narrative, values, goals, mood, traits, pastimes, calling), installed through set_background as an authored sheet is. Three cohorts, three people each; who gets which is drawn from the world seed. Temperament only: no sheet says what to do in a fight.

martial.narrative: I have fought for my living since I was young: escort work on the roads, a season with a warband, more brawls than I can count. A fight does not frighten me as much as it should, and I take pride in standing when others give way. I keep my spear in good order and expect others to keep theirs.
goals: be known as someone who does not break
teach a younger fighter what I know
martial.calling: the spear, and leading a few good fighters

martial.narrative: I was a guard for many years and I have seen what a fight costs. I do not go looking for trouble, but when it comes I meet it and see it through; I trust my training more than my luck. Younger ones call me cold. I call it having done this before.
goals: come through this with my name intact
find work that pays for a steady hand
martial.calling: keeping a gate or a road safe

martial.narrative: I want to prove myself. I am strong and quick and I hate losing at anything, from a footrace to an argument. People say I am reckless; I think they are slow. One day they will tell stories about me, and I mean to give them good ones.
goals: be first at everything I try
pastimes: racing anyone who will race me

protective.narrative: I am the one people stand behind. I have looked after my younger brothers and sisters since our mother died, and I cannot watch someone weaker get hurt without stepping in. I fight when I must, and I would rather take a blow than see one land on someone who cannot take it.
goals: see my brothers and sisters grown
be someone others can lean on

protective.narrative: I was a shepherd's hand for ten years, and the work taught me to count heads and keep the flock together. I do not think of myself as a fighter. But I know what it is to stand between a wolf and something that cannot run, and I have done it.
goals: keep the people near me whole
have a flock of my own one day

protective.narrative: I keep the peace among my neighbours: I settle quarrels, I fetch help, I am there when something goes wrong. I have a temper when someone picks on the weak, and I do not apologise for it. Mostly I just want everyone to get home.
pastimes: sitting late by the fire with friends

timid.narrative: I have never been good at fights. Loud voices and raised hands make my heart race, and I have always found some way to keep out of trouble. I am not proud of it, but I am still alive, and that counts for something.
goals: find a quiet place to live

timid.narrative: I am a weaver by trade, not a fighter. I was handed a spear and told to stand here, and I would rather be anywhere else. My hands are good at fine work and shake at this. I keep thinking of my loom and my half-finished cloth.

I am small and not strong, and I learned early to read a room before anyone else does. I notice when things are about to go wrong. People think I am a coward; I think I am careful. I have outlasted braver people than me.
pastimes: keeping a tally of the weather
